sloka: तदवस्थां च तां दृष्ट्वा महात्मा नलकूबरः ।अब्रवीत्किमिदं भद्रे पादयोः पतिता ऽसि मे ।। ७.२६.४६ ॥
transliteration: tadavasthāṁ ca tāṁ dṛṣṭvā mahātmā nalakūbaraḥ ।abravītkimidaṁ bhadre pādayoḥ patitā 'si me ।। 7.26.46 ॥

translations.english: Seeing her in that state, the great-souled Nalakubara asked, "O gentle one, what is this, that you have fallen at my feet?"
